verdict.rationale: PayPal's first-party Invoicing docs say merchants can create and send itemized invoices that are paid through a secure, hosted PayPal payment page. Invoices can be shared by secure URL, branded email or QR code, and merchants can configure automatic payment reminders. The Invoicing REST API and the agent tools (send_invoice, send_invoice_reminder) back this with programmatic coverage. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of invoicing and reminder behavior, and detailed docs on reminder scheduling options.
